hero.shortBio: Computer engineering student specializing in Artificial Intelligence & Data at EMSI. I design and develop solutions combining Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, frontend and backend development, software development and data processing, with practical experience in scraping, AI pipelines and model integration. I am looking for a final year project for 2027 in AI, Machine Learning or Data.

about.title: About Me
about.bio1: My journey in computer science has progressively led me to explore different aspects of development and digital technologies. After a third year mainly focused on development, during which I had the opportunity to work on several projects, I discovered in my fourth year another aspect of computer science through Artificial Intelligence and Data.
about.bio2: What particularly appeals to me in this field is its diversity: understanding a problem, asking the right questions, researching different approaches, experimenting and building a concrete solution. I am naturally curious and I enjoy learning new technologies by first understanding how they work, then putting them into practice.
about.bio3: I define myself today as a versatile and adaptable profile, with an interest in development, AI and Data. I also appreciate teamwork, where exchanges allow us to confront ideas and explore different solutions.
about.bio4: My goal for the future is to progressively move from academic learning to concrete professional problems, through a final year project that will allow me to both learn, contribute and put my skills into practice.
